minor.comment: A larger refactor. Saves now land in a draft workspace and an explicit Publish writes them to the repository as one commit — a working tree under the local connector, a draft store behind the provider connectors. The editor split into composable packages: an authentication-neutral runtime, the admin SPA as built assets, a server-only OIDC gate, and two composition roots — `@micacms/editor` (`npx`, loopback, no authentication code at all) and `@micacms/self-hosted` (Docker, behind OIDC). `MICA_MODE` is gone: the mode is which app you run. `@micacms/model` was renamed to `@micacms/core`.
